name: Another Memories
original_name: アナザー・メモリーズ
source:
Many years ago, the world was invaded by a great demon army wielding powerful magic. Many lives were lost, but the demon king was ultimately defeated. However, many demon soldiers remained, attacking from the shadows; to combat the demons, magic academies were established to train demon hunters, and eventually the demons were eradicated and peace returned to the land. However, these academies remain, and magic has become simply another part of daily life. The story begins with a young man named Jeynus, who has decided to join a magic academy and become a demon hunter.

Another Memories is a simulation adventure game from the creators of Yūkyū Gensōkyoku, with a focus on managing schedules and relationships as well as card-based battles. The player controls Jeynus, deciding his schedule for each week, exploring the campus and city and speaking with other students, and going on expeditions fighting creatures. Different activities will increase his stats, trigger various events and lead to relationships with the various female students, and determine his prospects and the game's ending after two in-game years. Combat takes the form of a deck-building card game, where the player can construct a deck of cards consisting of both element cards and spell cards, using them in turn-based battles.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/214731/another-memories/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
许多年前，世界被一支挥舞着强大魔法的恶魔大军入侵。许多人丧生，但魔王最终被击败。但仍有不少魔族士兵留下来，从暗处发起进攻。为了对抗恶魔，人们建立了魔法学院来培养恶魔猎手，最终消灭了恶魔，恢复了和平。然而，这些学院仍然存在，魔法已经成为日常生活的一部分。故事开始于一个名叫杰纳斯的年轻人，他决定加入魔法学院并成为一名恶魔猎手。

Another Memories是由《游急幻想曲》的创作者制作的一款模拟冒险游戏，重点是管理日程和关系以及基于卡牌的战斗。玩家控制杰纳斯，决定他每周的日程安排，探索校园和城市，与其他学生交谈，并继续与生物战斗的探险。不同的活动会增加他的统计数据，触发各种事件并导致与各种女学生的关系，并决定他的前景和游戏两年后的结局。战斗采用套牌构建卡牌游戏的形式，玩家可以构建一副由元素卡和咒语卡组成的牌，并在回合制战斗中使用它们。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/214731/another-memories/]MobyGames[/url]]
